messages:
rachel-docs: Quick thread  I'm updating the 'regional availability' page to add a small note about locale-specific model availability and the SDK migration examples. Want a fast review.

kevin-eng: yes please. drop the snippets here.

rachel-docs: plan: 1) short paragraph explaining best-effort routing + header, 2) JS SDK snippet for v1, 3) Python snippet for v0.8 compatibility, 4) footnote. Snippet: 
```js
// v1 SDK
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-xx', locale: 'zh-HK', residency: { strict: false } });
```

sam-qa: behavioral note: when strict=false we still set X-Redwood-Routed-Region and add X-Redwood-Routing-Mode: best-effort. If the model isn't available anywhere we return 503 rather than 409.

kevin-eng: slight correction: 503 is for capacity shortages; if no compatible model exists for locale we return 404-like error code residency_unavailable (422). I'll DM more.

legal-bot: please add: "Data routed outside the selected residency may be subject to processing in the region where the request executes. Use strict residency to enforce processing constraints."

rachel-docs: thanks all. will fold these into the page and ping for final check.

kevin-eng: +1 from eng once the error-code table is updated.

sam-qa: adding a short test plan for QA to the PR.

rachel-docs: PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4902 — includes table updates and example headers. CI checks pending.
